gloss_en: strengthening the angel (חִזּוּק הַמַּלְאָךְ) — reinforcing the power of the appointed angel who governs the growth of foods, so that demonic force (כח השד) cannot absorb the angel's weakened power and contaminate the foods, which would cause demon-induced dreams and nocturnal impurity (Likutey Moharan II:5); this strengthening is effected through joy and a glad heart
